static_traits.name: Zhang Di
static_traits.social_status: 社会支持系统not强，倾向于独自处理问题
static_traits.medical_history: not yet经历心理治疗；No major physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: 自一个月前起，一位常购车的客户not再回我的电话，我因此感到Persistent anxiety与压力；我认为他一定觉得我工作很糟，这引发自卑与Self-doubt，并使我害怕Being rejected，从而回避联系其他客户。
basic_info.core_demands: 这次寻求咨询的决定性因素是：意识到Anxiety与对工作能力的Self-doubt正在影响整体身心健康与工作表现。
growth_experiences: 过去在工作中曾遭遇过拒绝，短期内影响自尊但not yet升级到当前程度；此前not yet接受过任何心理治疗，且No major physical illness。

special_situations.event: 一位常购车的客户停止回电话已约一个月
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果客户not回我电话，就证明我工作很糟、not可被信任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试以not同方式联系该客户，但因害怕Being rejected而最终停止行动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他一定觉得我很糟/他讨厌我

special_situations.event: 当需要主动联系其他客户时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次Being rejected，就说明I am not suited for this job；必须避免进一步失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避拨打客户电话，尽量低调，not与他人互动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会拒绝我/have not人会接我的电话

special_situations.event: 想到工作相关的人际互动与业绩压力时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我有一次失误，not yet来都会搞砸；只有完美才算合格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过Self-doubt与Withdrawal来避免暴露not完美与失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会一直卖not出车/一切都会出错

special_situations.event: 与同事相处或想到同事可能看到自己的not足
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果同事看到我的缺点，他们就会认为I am a failure并看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 与同事隔离、减少互动以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会看not起我/他们觉得I am a failure

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与被接纳，尤其在工作表现上得到客户与同事的肯定
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被视为without能并被negate
defense_goal: 通过自我隔离与减少外部联系来避免遭遇negate
以Withdrawal与回避来维持脆弱自尊的安全感

object_relations.self_representation: An employee who is not good enough and prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: 批判性、随时会拒绝或轻视自己的他者（客户/同事）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当面对需要主动联系客户、而对方沉默或not yet回应时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方的沉默理解为对自己without能的negate（把Self-doubtProjection为他人的负面看法）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: useEmpathy且温和的语气，提出开放式问题帮助区分事实与假设；轻度挑战Projection内容，邀请列举证据与备用解释，避免指责与对立。

manifestations: 社会支持系统薄弱，倾向于独自承受问题
outcomes: Decline in work performance与Increased avoidance behavior

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 将客户的沉默解读为“他觉得我很糟”

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: 害怕Being rejected而避免拨打客户电话
在工作中“把头埋起来”，减少互动以Self-protection

exception_events.target_problem: 在需要联系客户时，来访者通常会因害怕Being rejected而回避拨打电话，导致销售机会减少与Decline in work performance。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 去年曾以为会失去一笔大单，但他主动致电客户后，对方最终购买了三辆车，结果明显好于Anticipation。
exception_events.reason: not同做法/心态：当时更有自信，have not让恐惧主导，选择主动联系客户；情境：客户当时可能有实际需求。

positive_force: Once proactively reached out in a major sales situation and achieved notable success (the customer bought three cars at once)
曾尝试以not同方式联系not回电的客户，具有一定的行动意愿
negative_force: 害怕Being rejected导致回避拨打电话
过度概括、读心术与预测not yet来等负性认知模式ReinforcementSelf-doubt
自卑与Self-denial，降低与同事的互动
Weak social support，倾向独自承受压力

target_behavior.behavior: 回避主动联系客户（尤其是电话沟通）
antecedent: 想到或需要进行工作相关的客户联络时
target_behavior.core_reason: 对Being rejected的灾难化预测与Self-doubt（将沉默/not yet回应等同于negate与失败）
target_behavior.function: 短期逃避潜在拒绝以暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 客户联络减少、销售机会流失、Decline in work performance，并进一步加重自卑与社交隔离
